svg.title: Re-anchoring one cited span on a newer commit
svg.desc: Decision tree for one citation. If the file has the same blob, the outcome is identical. If the path still exists, the exact span bytes are searched in that file: found once means unchanged or relocated (CURRENT), several times means ambiguous (UNVERIFIABLE), not at all means changed (STALE, with a line-diff proposal). If the path is gone, other files are searched by identical blob, then through the code index: one match is relocated, none is missing (UNVERIFIABLE). The finding takes the worst outcome of its parts.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
